services.desc: Studios, a nonprofit studio program for artists with disabilitiesJuly 9-July 27, 2026at Brick Aux Gallery Hot dogs, hot tempers, hot sticky nights. Sweaty backs, smelly feet, soft serve, short shorts, chilled beer, cold showers, Diet Coke with extra ice. Swimming pool splashes, block party beats, spitting hoses, sizzling grills. Summer in New York is upon us and YAI Arts is here to capture the spirit of the season in all its dripping, unruly glory. In the group exhibition HEATWAVE, YAI artists make snapshots of the sweetest bits of the longest days of the year, which somehow go by all too fast.
